newsitem.title: USA: US says no date for resumption of US-UK air talks.
newsitem.headline: US says no date for resumption of US-UK air talks.

text.p: There was no date set for the resumption of talks between the United States and Britain on a new air agreement, a Department of Transportation spokesman said Thursday.
"There are no dates outstanding. Really there is nothing to report at this time," said Bill Mosley when asked about a timetable for the resumption of talks.
The completion of a so-called "open skies" pact between the two countries is a necessary pre-condition for approving American Airlines proposed operating alliance with British Airways'.

Transportation Assistant Secretary Charles Hunnicutt told a Senate hearing Wednesday that formal talks with Britain had been temporarily halted due to the recent British election and competition reviews by London and the European Union.
Hunnicutt said progress had been made but the United States was insisting on a "competitively effective presence of U.S. carriers at London's Heathrow Airport."
